definitions.gloss: coat; fur; the lie of an animal's hair
definitions.explanation: The hair covering an animal, seen as a surface with a texture, color, and direction. Used when praising or assessing how an animal's coat looks.
A person's lineage or social background, judged as if it were an animal's coat. Almost always in {毛並|けな}みがいい, which can be admiring or faintly sarcastic depending on tone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{毛並|けな}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧だ。
{毛並|けな}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧⟦ブラシをかける→ブラシをかける：23722_burashiwokakeru⟧。
examples.english: Brush along the lie of the fur.

examples.japanese: ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{世話|せわ}→世話：02088_sewa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{馬|うま}→馬：01865_uma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{毛並|けな}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つや⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: A well-cared-for horse has a noticeably glossier coat.
He comes from a good family.

examples.japanese: {毛並|けな}み⟦のよ→のよ：30249_noyo⟧さ⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧わけ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: He wasn't chosen just for his pedigree.

examples.japanese: {毛並|けな}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦{顔|かお}ぶれ→顔ぶれ：14671_kaobure⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{有権者|ゆうけんしゃ}→有権者：13021_yuukensha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冷|つめ}たかった→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧。
examples.english: Voters were cold toward a lineup made up entirely of politicians from privileged backgrounds.

notes:
⟦{毛|け}→毛：01392_ke⟧ (hair) + {並|な}み (the way things are lined up): how the hair lies. Sense 2 extends the same image to people.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {毛並|けな}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: to have a fine coat; to be well-born
- {毛並|けな}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{整|ととの}う→整う：03935_totonou⟧: the coat is sleek and even
- {毛並|けな}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧: along the lie of the fur

USAGE:
- Sense 2 is used of people only in the {毛並|けな}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ / {毛並|けな}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ pattern. It carries a whiff of the racehorse or show dog, so it can sound admiring or mildly mocking; it is not a neutral way to describe someone's family.
